Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Talk with a nonhostile gathering for ten minutes to find a host who offers your party food, a bed and a useful local introduction.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes sharing conversation or news.
Target / range / shape
A nonhostile gathering whose members can understand you.
Limits
Once per visit to a community.
Type
Skill / Utility

After the conversation, the DA introduces a willing local host who offers your party an ordinary meal and a place to sleep until the next morning. The host also points you toward one local person who can help with your stated business.
